purpose: Direction-balanced fixed-camera 2D path counterfactual for Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B

prompt.positive: A single glossy bright-red ball on a matte white tabletop, locked-off camera, soft even daylight. The ball moves smoothly and stays fully visible in frame.
prompt.foreground: A single glossy bright-red ball moves smoothly and stays fully visible in frame.
prompt.background: A locked-off camera, matte white tabletop, soft even daylight, simple clean background.
prompt.negative: text, watermark, blurry image, JPEG artifacts

annotation_center_definition: Use the midpoint of the manually drawn tight object box for the primary center-path score; the scorer derives center from box coordinates. Keep box extent/IoU as a separate guardrail. Record identity ambiguity and visibility in their explicit fields, and use notes for occlusion or blur context.

scoring.monotonicity_rule: Count only adjacent frame pairs where both are visible; report that denominator.
scoring.point_tracker_rule: A tracked surface point on a rolling ball is not the projected object center; use only as a cross-check.

pilot_gate.runtime_smoke: One seed; complete all three arms and verify path-to-latent mapping, shared-noise hashes, output frame count, peak VRAM, and wall time.
pilot_gate.causal_smoke: Same direction-neutral prompt and shared start/noise for left/right paths; the full control must produce the requested signed endpoint response and improve independent center error over both controls.
